description.narrative: The proposed project readiness loan will finance the preparation of the feasibility study and the detailed engineering design including bidding documents and procurement support for the: (i) Northern region road corridor (Mamose international highway) between Wutung and Angoram, and (ii) Highlands Region Road Improvement Investment Program - Phase 2, including approximately 150 km of roads on the Highlands core network to be defined later, and (iii) Northern region road corridor Wau-Bulolo highway between Lae and Malaluwa.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 6032: 90% of contracts awarded and 42% disbursed as of 08 Apr 2025
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Aug 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/53325/53325-001-apfs-en_0.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: As of Q1 2025: (i) Progress Reports No. 5 and 6 for Momase international highway have been submitted by the consultant and are under review by DOWH and ADB; (ii) Progress Report No. 2 for MRIRP2 - Core Road Newtork has been submitted, reviewed, and for approval; and (iii) Progress Reports No. 4a and 4b for MRIRP - Bulolo Junction are under preparation. Surveys and investigation activities are ongoing for all assignments. The consulting firm engaged to design the two bridges of SHRCRNP is having discussions with DOWH on contract extension and revised work program.The PIU was established in December 2021 with complete staffing by March 2022. The PIU has supported DOWH in the selection process of the consulting firms. The DOWH, PIU, and ADB have been having regular meetings since April 2021 to monitor the status of the progress and agree on the next actions. The PIU has initially followed direct payment procedures to process the PIU staff claims. These procedures are being used also to process the firms' claims. The PIU has supported DOWH in the activation and utilization of advance account and trust account per PAM. During project team's review mission in March 2023, it was noted that the provincial DOWH offices in Vanimo and Wewak are understaffed which may compromise the Northern region road corridor project (Momase international highway) from Wutung to Wewak, including Vanimo and Wewak ports preparation and implementation considering the extensive scope of the project. Assuming that it is challenging to recruit senior staff, DOWH should start identifying suitable junior staff and recruit young experts to be trained, with ADB support, during the project preparation.In Q3 2023, the two Project Financial Management and Accounting Support positions that were advertised to support PIU's FM team, were cancelled due to low turnout of suitable candidates despite several extensions of the deadline for EOI submission. ADB project team recommended that the EA consider revising the TOR and adjusting the proposed cost estimates. As of end Q1 2025, PIU has one international highway design engineer, one international procurement specialist, one international financial management specialist, one national project manager, one national deputy project manager, and one national project accountant. The recruitment activities for one national social safeguards expert and one national gender specialist are ongoing. Other additional positions identified to support the PIU are still under review and discussions by DOWH.
